doc.digest: Retrieve notes and contextual data of MIDI clips in Live. Designed for use in a MIDI Tool Generator or MIDI Tool Transformation.
doc.description: The live.miditool.in object is used in a MIDI Tool Generator or MIDI Tool Transformation and is responsible for retrieving note and contextual information of the currently selected clip in Live. In combination with the live.miditool.out object, you can develop a generative or transformative process that can be controlled and triggered from the Tool Tabs.

outlets.digest: Dictionary containing the notes from Live

methods.name: bang
methods.digest: Triggers the retrieval of the clip data and starts or continues an iteration of an apply cycle.
